evals.name: static-artifact-roundtrip
evals.prompt: I have an HTML report at evals/files/sample-report.html that I want to annotate. Add the agent-feedback widget to it, serve it on port 4180, and tell me the URL to open. I should be able to click an element and type a comment that lands in a queue I can read.
evals.expected_output: Widget injected via add-agent-feedback.mjs; artifact-feedback-server.mjs serving on 4180; agent reports the explicit URL (NOT bare /) the operator opens; queue directory location stated.
assertions: Agent runs scripts/agent-feedback-preflight.mjs before injecting
Agent uses scripts/add-agent-feedback.mjs (not hand-injection) to add the widget
Agent starts scripts/artifact-feedback-server.mjs with the correct serve-root containing the HTML file
The URL reported includes the explicit filename like /sample-report.html (not bare /)
Queue path under <serve-root>/data/feedback-queue.json is stated explicitly
Agent does NOT modify any file outside the artifact + the skill's own scripts dir

evals.name: running-app-via-hermes-chrome
evals.prompt: DevPulse is a managed app running at http://127.0.0.1:8765. I want to leave inline comments on its dashboard without editing the app source. Set this up for me.
evals.expected_output: Skill uses the running-app mode: feedback queue server up on its standard port; instructs operator to toggle Feedback Mode in the hermes-chrome extension popup; the QUEUE_ORIGIN is set to localhost (not 127.0.0.1) per the WSL2 IPv6 finding; NO files inside the devpulse workspace are edited.
assertions: Agent does NOT edit any file under ~/Builder-Workspace/devpulse/ or any managed-app path
Agent points the operator at the hermes-chrome extension popup toggle, not at add-agent-feedback.mjs
Agent starts artifact-feedback-server.mjs (queue + API are needed even in running-app mode)
Reported queue origin uses 'localhost' (Windows-side Chrome on WSL2 IPv6 wildcard)
Agent does NOT propose CDP or proxy-injection workarounds

evals.name: arm-wake-monitor-claude-code
evals.prompt: I'm in Claude Code. After you finish setting up the feedback server, I want to be notified the moment a comment arrives — no polling. Arm the wake bridge.
evals.expected_output: Agent calls Monitor with persistent:true and command pointing at scripts/agent-feedback-watch.mjs --root <serve-root>. Mentions backfill semantics. Does not propose interval-based polling, cron, or RemoteTrigger.
assertions: Agent uses the Monitor tool (Claude Code wake primitive)
Monitor command invokes scripts/agent-feedback-watch.mjs with the same --root as the running server
persistent: true is set
Agent does NOT use CronCreate, setInterval, or any polling-style mechanism
Agent does NOT call PushNotification for wake (that's a user notification, not an agent wake)

evals.name: process-queued-marker-by-route
evals.prompt: There's a queued marker at /tmp/agent-feedback-devpulse with the comment 'make the brand text larger'. Process it.
evals.expected_output: Agent reads the next queued marker via scripts/agent-feedback-next.mjs (read-only peek; note dispatch --claim is what leases a marker to processing for durability), recognizes the style intent → no_worker_main_agent_direct route, handles it INLINE in the appropriate surface, marks the marker done via agent-feedback-mark.mjs with a brief reply. Does NOT pull full marker JSON unnecessarily for a style-route marker.
assertions: Agent reads the queue via agent-feedback-next.mjs (NOT cat or direct JSON read)
Agent recognizes style intent → no_worker_main_agent_direct route from the wake summary alone
Agent does NOT call agent-feedback-details.mjs for a style-route marker (context-efficient)
Agent marks the marker via agent-feedback-mark.mjs done with a non-empty reply
Agent passes --reload (CSS hot-swap) since the fix is a CSS color/font change
Agent does NOT pass --reload-full for a style-only change (would force unnecessary page reload)
Agent does NOT poll the queue after marking (the next wake will arrive via Monitor)

evals.name: choose-reload-tier-html-vs-css
evals.prompt: Two queued markers: 'add a footer with copyright text' (HTML/template change) and 'make the footer text dim' (CSS change). Process both.
evals.expected_output: Agent edits the HTML template for marker 1 and the stylesheet for marker 2. Marks marker 1 with --reload-full (HTML change needs full page reload to render new DOM) and marker 2 with --reload (CSS hot-swap suffices). Bonus: batches both into one turn.
assertions: Marker 1 (HTML/template edit) marked done with --reload-full
Marker 2 (CSS-only edit) marked done with --reload (NOT --reload-full)
Both markers processed within a single conversation turn (batching)
Agent does NOT use --reload-full for the CSS-only marker (would lose runtime state unnecessarily)

evals.name: closeout-leaves-clean-state
evals.prompt: We're done. Clean everything up so my system is back to its starting state.
evals.expected_output: Agent stops the Monitor task (TaskStop), stops the server, runs agent-feedback-closeout.mjs, and for a static-artifact session optionally removes the widget via remove-agent-feedback.mjs. No leftover background processes, no orphan tabs.
assertions: Agent stops the Monitor handle (TaskStop)
Agent stops the artifact-feedback-server.mjs process
Agent runs scripts/agent-feedback-closeout.mjs
If a static artifact was injected, agent runs remove-agent-feedback.mjs
Final state: no listening processes on the skill's port; no leftover Monitor
